name: Macro-armed capitulation squeeze: deep-negative funding + extreme fear, gated by a non-panic tape (long-only spot)
rationale: Funding-carry alone and Fear&Greed-alone are both exhausted. The orthogonal claim is a positioning+sentiment COMPOSITE that is ARMED only when the macro tape is NOT itself in free-fall, so it captures a local crypto SQUEEZE rather than a systemic de-risking bleed. Long only when ALL hold: (i) funding_rate deeply negative (crowded shorts paying longs = squeeze fuel), (ii) fear_greed in extreme-fear, (iii) vix_level BELOW a fitted panic ceiling AND macro_regime not deep risk-off (the arming gate: crypto fear is idiosyncratic, not a macro rout). Documented funding bottoms (Coindesk Apr-2026 most-negative funding since 2023 marked the bottom; Phemex 46-day negative-funding study) resolve UP only when the macro stress is crypto-local. DISCONFIRMERS this spec must beat net of fees: (1) fear_greed<floor alone (the exhausted Fear&Greed contrarian); (2) negative-funding alone; (3) funding+fear WITHOUT the vix/macro arming gate. If the un-gated composite (3) already captures the return, the macro arming gate -- the actual claim -- is worthless and this is just buy-the-dip rebuilt. Low turnover: deep-funding + extreme-fear co-occurrences are a handful per year.
catalyst: deeply negative perp funding plus extreme fear, while the macro tape (VIX/regime) is calm enough that the crypto fear is idiosyncratic, not a systemic rout
